requirements.text: Strong programming skills in C or C++ (C++11 or newer), with experience developing production software.
Experience developing applications or middleware on Linux or another POSIX-based operating system.
Understanding of object-oriented design, modular software architecture, and API design.
Experience with multi-threaded software and concurrency concepts.
Understanding of inter-process communication and client/server software architectures.
Experience designing or developing software that manages persistent application or system data.
Understanding of data modeling, schemas, transactions, concurrency, and data integrity.
Experience debugging application and system-level software using Linux development tools.
Familiarity with networking concepts and protocols such as TCP/IP.
Ability to understand and work with software interfaces in heterogeneous computing systems involving CPUs and hardware-accelerated components.
Experience with software configuration management, code reviews, and unit/integration testing.
Working knowledge of Python or shell scripting for development, testing, or automation.
Strong written and verbal communication skills and ability to work effectively in a cross-functional engineering team.
Bachelor’s degree with 6+ years of industry experience, or Master’s degree with 4+ years of industry experience, in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related engineering discipline.
4+ years of hands-on experience developing and supporting embedded systems in a production environment.
Experience developing middleware, platform services, or reusable software frameworks.
Experience developing software for heterogeneous computing platforms involving CPUs, GPUs, FPGAs, DSPs, or other accelerators.
Experience integrating software with GPU-accelerated or FPGA-based subsystems.
Experience with embedded or local data persistence technologies such as SQLite.
Experience developing configuration, preferences, or system-state management services.
Experience with IPC technologies such as sockets, shared memory, message queues, or RPC frameworks.
Familiarity with serialization technologies such as protobuf or JSON.
Experience developing embedded Linux applications.
Familiarity with systemd or similar Linux service-management frameworks.
Experience with asynchronous or event-driven application architectures.
Familiarity with Yocto/OpenEmbedded or embedded Linux build environments.
Experience with medical devices, robotics, automotive, industrial automation, or other complex embedded systems.
Experience working in regulated, safety-critical, or mission-critical product development environments.
